description: This file implements the CCSP Message Bus Interface for the CCSP Secure Software Download environment, including functions for engaging with the message bus, handling messages, and managing resources.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a certain condition related to the message bus is ready.

methods.name: T2_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages and delegates to base path message function.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_GetHealth
methods.description: Returns the health status from the component's common data model.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initializes and connects to the message bus, registers callbacks and events.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks for the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks for the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_T2Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus interface.
